method: Engine replays on one-minute closes, 4 Oct 2023 to 30 Sep 2026, gross on ₹3,20,000 of fixed model capital. Costs are slippage plus charges per trade, per unit: 4.6 points is what real fills on a similar algo lost against its published prices. Research strategies stay in the code for replays; they are not paper traded.

notes.name: Damper Intraday, low drawdown
notes.source: Tuned from Stratzy’s Damper Credit Spread
notes.verdict: Not listed: the profit per trade is smaller than realistic trading costs.
notes.summary: An intraday NIFTY credit spread that is flat by 14:54 every day. It met the goal it was tuned for, a drawdown under 20% with steady years, but it trades almost daily for about 2.5 points a trade. Two points of slippage and charges remove the profit.

stats.label: Return per year after 2 points of costs

costs.name: Ratio-Fluxer Afternoon Credit
costs.note: Listed, for comparison · about 1 trade a month

findings: Uses the Zen Variance signal with Damper’s same-day exit, a stop at credit + 40 and one re-entry after a stop.
A profit lock moves the stop to break-even once 20% of the credit is earned; the target is 50% of the credit. This raised average win ÷ average loss from 0.65 to 1.39.
Lots are capped so one stop loses at most 2.5% of capital, which brought the drawdown from 31% to under 18%.
About 10% of exits had no cached price for the hedge leg. The figures value it from its last trade; booking it at zero gives 15% a year with a 20.2% drawdown.
Tuned on all three years, so there is no untouched test period.

notes.name: Damper replica
notes.source: Replica of Stratzy’s Damper Credit Spread (Dhan Algos)
notes.verdict: Not listed: an 84% drawdown over three years and a losing second year.
notes.summary: Damper’s 316 published trades turned out to be the Zen Geometric signal traded intraday. The replica takes the same side on the same day for 220 of the 275 published trades in the year they overlap, but the year before Damper went live is a heavy loss.

costs.name: Ratio-Fluxer Afternoon Credit
costs.note: Listed, for comparison · about 1 trade a month

findings: Rules found from the published trades: 400-point hedge, entries from 10:15, stop near credit + 40, target when the spread is worth 10 or less, everything closed at 14:54.
After a stop it enters once more that day, usually on the other side two minutes later. After a target or a time exit it stops for the day.
On the 178 trades matched to the minute and strike, the simulation made ₹4.39L against Damper’s published ₹4.31L.
Damper’s published record starts in September 2025, so it never shows the losing year before.
